newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to offer up to 15 mln pounds 91 day bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to offer up to 15 mln pounds 91 day bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will offer up to 15 million pounds ($29.5million) in 91-day treasury bills with a February 26 issue date, the bank said on Wednesday.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, can be made from February 24 to February 26 at 9.00 local time (0700 GMT).
Competitive bids will be accepted in part or in whole if the price is equal to or higher than that set by the central bank.
Those making non-competitive bids will pay the average price of all bids submitted and accepted by the central bank.
Treasury bill auctions are held twice a month. ($=0.51 pounds) -- Nicosia newsroom 357 2 365089
